scenarios.description: A hypothesis with no supporting or contradicting evidence at all.
scenarios.scoring_explanation: 0 supporting item(s) and 0 contradicting item(s) across 0 distinct source(s). Composite support=0.50, status=inconclusive. Scores are bounded support indicators, not calibrated probabilities.
scenarios.rationale: With no evidence the system must not claim any support; insufficient evidence cannot yield a supported conclusion.

scenarios.description: Three direct measurement items, all from one document.
scenarios.scoring_explanation: 3 supporting item(s) and 0 contradicting item(s) across 1 distinct source(s). Composite support=0.82, status=review_required. Scores are bounded support indicators, not calibrated probabilities.
scenarios.rationale: Repeated claims from the same source are not independent corroboration, so a single-source hypothesis must be flagged for review instead of 'supported'.

scenarios.description: Direct high-reliability items from three distinct documents.
scenarios.scoring_explanation: 3 supporting item(s) and 0 contradicting item(s) across 3 distinct source(s). Composite support=0.86, status=supported. Scores are bounded support indicators, not calibrated probabilities.
scenarios.rationale: Independent direct corroboration from multiple sources is the intended basis for a supported hypothesis.

scenarios.description: One weak supporting item against two strong contradicting items.
scenarios.scoring_explanation: 1 supporting item(s) and 2 contradicting item(s) across 1 distinct source(s). Composite support=0.26, status=contradicted. Scores are bounded support indicators, not calibrated probabilities.
scenarios.rationale: When contradicting evidence clearly outweighs support, the hypothesis should be marked contradicted rather than supported.

scenarios.scoring_explanation: 1 supporting item(s) and 1 contradicting item(s) across 1 distinct source(s). Composite support=0.56, status=inconclusive. Scores are bounded support indicators, not calibrated probabilities.
scenarios.rationale: Balanced conflicting evidence must remain inconclusive; the system should not force a conclusion.

scenarios.description: A single low-reliability, low-relevance supporting item against two strong contradicting items.
scenarios.scoring_explanation: 1 supporting item(s) and 2 contradicting item(s) across 1 distinct source(s). Composite support=0.24, status=contradicted. Scores are bounded support indicators, not calibrated probabilities.
scenarios.rationale: Unreliable, low-relevance support should not survive strong contradicting evidence; the hypothesis is contradicted.
